No, no, I haven't been doing any of that. I don't really drink much anyway, maybe just a glass of wine at Thanksgiving or something. We always have Thanksgiving at my sister's house. She makes this incredible sweet potato casserole with the marshmallows on top. I know some people think it's too sweet, like dessert, but it's a family tradition. Our grandmother used to make it in this huge, heavy ceramic dish that had a tiny chip on one of the handles. 

My sister actually inherited that dish. She keeps it on the top shelf of her pantry because she's terrified her kids are going to break it. Her youngest, Leo, is a total hurricane. He's six now, and he just runs through the house knocking things over. Last time I was there, he knocked over a vase of fake sunflowers. I don't really get the appeal of fake flowers, honestly. They just collect dust. Real flowers are so much better, even if they don't last as long. I used to keep a real orchid on my desk at work, but the air conditioning in the office is so aggressive it just sort of wilted and died within a month. 

The maintenance guy, Dave, says he can't adjust the vents because the whole floor is on one central system. Dave's a good guy, though. He always has these crazy stories about his fishing trips up at the lake...

Wait, sorry. What did you ask me? Oh, right, drugs and alcohol. No, I haven't been using anything like that. Just my regular coffee in the morning.

turns.doctor_question: Do the voices or unusual beliefs ever happen only when your mood is not high or low, or only during those mood episodes?
turns.patient_response:
Well, it's kind of a mix, honestly. Like I said, I definitely get the voices and the feeling about the secret tests even when my mood is totally steady and normal. But... when I'm in one of those high-energy stretches, you know, when I'm running on barely any sleep and fixing everything? The feeling definitely gets stronger. Like, I'll be absolutely certain that a glitch in the office calendar or a weirdly worded email is this incredibly important, special message meant just for me. And I'll sometimes hear those short comments or voices right in the middle of all that rushing around. 

Speaking of the office calendar, we just switched to this new software system last month, and it is a total nightmare. The interface is completely counterintuitive. You try to schedule a recurring meeting, and it somehow invites the entire department instead of just the three people you selected. My boss, Mr. Thompson, was furious when he got fifty decline notifications for a simple check-in meeting. He's not great with technology anyway. He still prints out all his emails to read them. He has this massive stack of paper on his desk that just keeps growing. 

I keep telling him we need to go paperless. It's better for the environment, anyway. I started recycling more at home, too. I got one of those dual trash cans with the separate compartments. It's stainless steel, looks really sleek in the kitchen. But the bags for it are so expensive. You have to buy the specific brand or they don't fit right around the rim. I tried using regular grocery bags once, but they just slipped down inside and made a huge mess with the coffee grounds. 

I drink a lot of coffee, especially when I'm on one of those high-energy kicks. I have this French press that makes the best cup... 

Oh, wait. Sorry. I'm doing it again, aren't I? But yeah, the voices and the beliefs happen when I'm normal, but they definitely get more intense and I hear the comments more when I'm in those super high-energy, no-sleep periods.

Wait, sorry, I lost track again. But yes, absolutely. Even when my mood is perfectly normal and stable, those voices and the coded test things have definitely lasted for two weeks or more.
